#
# The Fedora packages CI installs to configure, build and test
# phosphor-components and phosphor-libs under it. One package per line. A
# comment after `#` is ignored.
gcc-c++
git
ccache
cmake
ninja-build
extra-cmake-modules
qt6-qtbase-devel
qt6-qtbase-private-devel
qt6-qtdeclarative-devel
qt6-qtshadertools-devel
qt6-qtsvg-devel
qt6-qtwayland-devel
wayland-devel
wayland-protocols-devel
# lupdate and lrelease, for the components' catalog.
qt6-qttools-devel
# Qt declares QVulkanInstance only when the Vulkan headers are present, and
# phosphor-libs' phosphor-surfaces uses it wherever Qt was built with Vulkan.
vulkan-headers
# KF6: the components draw through Kirigami. KGlobalAccel and PlasmaActivities
# are optional lookups in phosphor-libs, installed so CI builds what they
# switch on.
kf6-kirigami-devel
kf6-kglobalaccel-devel
plasma-activities-devel
# The test bus and the offscreen tests' runtime.
dbus-daemon
mesa-dri-drivers
mesa-libEGL
